Application Data.NAME: ABC Flooring Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Flooring Solutions specializes in the retail sale, installation, and maintenance of a wide range of floor coverings, including carpet, tile, vinyl, and hardwood flooring. Our operations are primarily conducted from a fixed showroom location, where we showcase various flooring options and provide consultation services to customers. We employ trained technicians for installation, ensuring high-quality workmanship and customer satisfaction. Additionally, we offer on-site assessments and measurements to facilitate accurate installations. Our commitment to safety and quality ensures that we adhere to industry standards in all our operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a minor fire incident occurred in the storage area due to an electrical malfunction, resulting in damage to some flooring materials and equipment. The estimated loss amount was $5,000. The claim is currently under review and has not yet been settled.
